directive.thread_id: team lead brief to the site deploy builder, Nov 24 2026 (two broken site builds went live with every server-side check green)
directive.quote: Build a Workshop tool that checks every page kind of a site build in Chromium against the live site and refuses (non-zero) on regressions

job: open each page kind of a built site in a browser beside the live site and refuse the build when a page is blank, throws a new page error or reads in a serif font where the live page does not

phrasings: check every page kind of a site build in a browser against the live site
refuse a site build whose page is blank or throws a page error
serve a built site folder locally and pass data calls to the live site
